steps.en: Review the license and install the five research-family skills and required backend
steps.zh: 核对许可，安装研究家族与所需后端

steps.en: Give a bounded research topic, period, geography and languages
steps.zh: 提供研究主题、时间、地区与语言范围

steps.en: Plan public discovery and return candidate sources
steps.zh: 规划公开搜索，返回候选来源

steps.en: Guide original-source checks and bind claims to evidence
steps.zh: 引导核对原文，将主张绑定证据

component.zh: 按研究技能执行的 agent

steps.en: Check scope and evidence structure; expose blocking gaps before synthesis
steps.zh: 综合前检查范围与证据结构，披露阻断缺口

value.en: Research has an explicit candidate-to-claim trail rather than an untraceable long answer
value.zh: 研究留下候选到主张的明确路径，不再只交不可追溯的长答案
